text:
alex: Hi everyone, first day! On M2 Mac and also using WSL. Followed quickstart but ruby/gems and some npm native modules fail to build (openssl / pkg-config errors). Also not sure where to put REDWOOD_API_KEY locally and how we handle kubeconfig for dev cluster. Any minimal bootstrap hints?

maria: welcome! TL;DR: brew + asdf + direnv, set openssl flags on mac, install build deps on WSL, use direnv for secrets. Quick commands:
brew install asdf openssl@3 pkg-config
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig"
# then asdf install ruby <ver>
# WSL: sudo apt install build-essential libssl-dev zlib1g-dev pkg-config

maria: For native npm modules that require Rust, run rustup and add ~/.cargo/bin to PATH. For node we use corepack + pnpm in most repos.

maria: Secrets: do NOT commit. Put local exports in ~/.config/redwood/env.local and source with direnv from .envrc. Example: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-local-xxx; export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-redwood

devops: To get kubeconfig, open the onboarding form (pinned in #new-hires) or DM me. We'll provision a per-user context and send the file; place it at ~/.kube/config-redwood and set KUBECONFIG or merge it.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4950 for alex to get repo and kube access.

alex: Thanks! I'll try the openssl flags and direnv flow, will post errors here if anything breaks.
